name: ONNX Runtime
one_liner: Cross-platform accelerator for running trained models.
what_it_is: A cross-platform machine-learning model accelerator with a flexible interface to integrate hardware-specific libraries, in its own words. A model trained elsewhere is exported to the ONNX format and executed through whichever hardware backend the target machine provides.
why_it_matters: It separates where a model is trained from where it runs, which is what lets one exported artefact serve a server, a phone and a browser. The export step is the catch: an operation the format does not cover has to be replaced or implemented before the model will convert.
suitable_for: Deploying one model across several hardware targets
Inference on machines without the training framework installed
not_suitable_for: Training — it executes models rather than fitting them
Models using operations the format does not represent
Fast-moving research code, where re-exporting on every change is friction
